mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.description: Connect an AI assistant to the MCP tools provided by this service.
mcp.overview: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint lets compatible assistants call this service’s API tools. Each request is authenticated, and the token determines which operations are available.
mcp.aliases: The same handler is also available at these direct aliases:
mcp.authentication: Every request requires Authorization: Bearer with an existing owner or operator API token. Create a linked token for this client. Never use your primary owner token or the operator token. Cookies are ignored.
mcp.tools_note: This live list reflects the operations exposed to the current visitor. Operator credentials may see additional tools.
mcp.tools_caption: MCP tools available to this token
mcp.no_tools: No tools are available for this token.
mcp.limits: The endpoint accepts POST requests only and does not create sessions. It uses the API rate limits, audit logging, validation, and ownership checks. Origins are validated. Supported protocol version: 2026-07-28.
mcp.error_400: Unsupported protocol version or missing/mismatched request headers.
mcp.fix_400: Use protocol version 2026-07-28 and matching MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, and, for named operations, Mcp-Name headers.
mcp.error_401: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.
mcp.fix_401: Send a valid owner or operator API token in the Authorization header.
mcp.error_403: The request Origin is not permitted.
mcp.fix_403: Use the service origin or configure the origin in the CORS allow-list.
mcp.error_405: The request used a method other than POST.

cli.server_help:
{binary_name} - Universal API Toolkit

Usage: {binary_name} [options]

Server options:
  --help, -h              Show this help
  --version, -v           Show version
  --status                Show service status
  --mode MODE             Set mode: production, development, or debug
  --config DIR            Configuration directory
  --data DIR              Data directory
  --log DIR               Log directory
  --cache DIR             Cache directory
  --backup DIR            Backup directory
  --pid FILE              PID file path
  --address ADDR          Listen address (default: 0.0.0.0)
  --port PORT             Listen port (default: 64580)
  --baseurl URL           Public URL path prefix
  --i2p                   Enable the I2P eepsite
  --daemon                Run as a background daemon
  --debug                 Enable debug mode
  --color MODE            Color output: auto|yes|no
  --lang CODE             Set interface language
  --shell ACTION [SHELL]  Shell integration: completions|init|help

Service: --service COMMAND (use --service --help)
Maintenance: --maintenance COMMAND (use --maintenance --help)
Updates: --update COMMAND (use --update --help)
Email: email test [recipient]
Tor: --tor COMMAND (use --tor --help)

Environment: MODE CONFIG_DIR DATA_DIR CACHE_DIR LOG_DIR BACKUP_DIR PID_FILE PORT LISTEN DEBUG
Signals: SIGHUP reloads config; SIGTERM/SIGINT stop; SIGUSR1 reopens logs; SIGUSR2 dumps status.
Documentation: https://apimgr-api.readthedocs.io
